verdict.rationale: There is a public GitHub repository at github.com/superset-sh/superset, which is where the README content in the gh items comes from. A community commenter praising the "project architecture" and "cleanness" suggests the source is inspectable. However, nothing in the pack names the license or confirms it is open-source. Missing for 10: an explicitly stated open license (e.g., a LICENSE file or docs statement), confirmation that the full product source rather than just a README is public, and independent corroboration of open-source status.
